BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

You might find it here.

How do I get a shipping quote?+

Use our quote form to share your goods, quantity, approximate weight or dimensions, shipping method, and destination. It prepares a WhatsApp message for you to review and send. Our team confirms the charges after reviewing your shipment.

Where do I send my goods in China?+

Contact the China team before dispatch. The Guangzhou address listed on our locations page is for the sea warehouse. For air freight, request the correct receiving instructions separately.

How do I get a shipment update?+

Contact the team handling your shipment and share your customer name, shipment reference if provided, goods description, and the date you handed over your cargo. Updates are currently handled directly by our team.
